scope: Full deb install/upgrade/removal lifecycle inside a disposable rootless Bubblewrap user and mount namespace. The staged root was writable under /tmp; host system paths were not writable and host package state remained unchanged.

dependency_basis.apt_result: APT resolved all required dependencies from the installed Debian 13 providers (including t64 virtual providers) and planned only Reverie.
dependency_basis.dpkg_execution: Used a copy of the host dpkg status database and read-only host runtime libraries/tools; dpkg install ran without --force-depends and emitted no unsatisfied-dependency errors.
dependency_basis.limitation: This verifies package lifecycle against the host dependency inventory in isolation; it does not modify or verify the host dpkg database and does not launch the installed desktop.

checks: CLI and GUI symlinks point into /opt/Reverie
CLI and GUI symlinks remain valid

host_unchanged.host_dpkg_query: Package reverie was not installed before or after the isolated test (dpkg-query exit 1).
